meta.name: caveman-stats
meta.description: Show real token usage and estimated savings for the current session, read from the session log. Trigger: /caveman-stats.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 实时查看本次会话的用量与省费估算
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你平时用 AI 助手,想知道每次会话的 token 花费。
copy.tagline_en: See real-time token usage and savings for the current session.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI tools and want to track token spend per session.

howto.what: 输入 /caveman-stats 后，Claude 会从会话记录中读出当前会话的真实 token 用量与估算节省，并立即显示数字。有节省估算时还会显示“Est. rule overhead”和“Est. net”；若净节省为负，会直说并建议关掉 caveman。
howto.when: 当用户在当前会话中输入 /caveman-stats 命令时触发，立即显示统计，不依赖模型处理。

say.text: 帮我看看这次会话用了多少 token，大概省了多少。
say.note: 会显示真实用量与节省估算。
直接查看当前会话统计、规则开销和净节省。

howto.what_en: Entering /caveman-stats makes the tool read the session log and display the session's real token usage and estimated savings immediately. When a savings estimate exists, it shows 'Est. rule overhead' and 'Est. net'; if net savings is negative, it says so plainly and suggests turning caveman off.
howto.when_en: It triggers when the user types /caveman-stats in the current session and shows the numbers without model processing.

say_en.text: Can you show my token usage and savings for this session?
say_en.note: Shows real usage and savings estimate.
Shows current-session stats, rule overhead, and net savings.
